about: Owen Sound is a city at the head of Owen Sound harbour on Georgian Bay, in Grey County, Ontario. Steep harbour hills drop to a working waterfront and a compact downtown, with trails climbing into the Niagara Escarpment. It anchors the region’s hospital, retail, and ferry-access corridors toward the Bruce Peninsula. About 22,000 people live in Owen Sound.
